item.description:
### Added - **Cursor: sessions started with `agent persist` now show up.** Cursor keeps these running in the background after you close the terminal, and Perch missed them entirely. They now get a row, whether a terminal is attached or not, and you can reply to one from your phone even while it's detached. - **Cursor: a session waiting for you to trust its folder now shows up.** Cursor asks "Do you trust the contents of this directory?" the first time you open it somewhere new. Until you answered, the session was missing from Perch. It now reads "Waiting for you to trust this folder".
### Fixed - **Cursor: Stats, the last reply and the conversation now work for every project folder.** For a folder whose path has an underscore, a dot, a space or a double dash, Perch looked for Cursor's transcript in the wrong place and found nothing. Stats recounts your Cursor history once after updating.
